description.value: Pulp Fiction Coffee House is a one-of-a-kind café in downtown Kelowna where freshly roasted espresso drinks share space with rare pulp fiction books, Art Deco antiques, and vivid jacket-cover art, all curated by owner Max Sloan over a 45-year career of global collecting. Situated on the corner of Pandosy and Lawrence, the groovy retro interior spills into back rooms filled with glowing Art Deco globes, old clocks, and collectible book cover prints. Touring cyclists will find a genuinely distinctive and unhurried rest stop that doubles as a small museum of mid-century popular culture.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, email) and confirms the business is actively operating as a physical café in downtown Kelowna. The food menu explicitly names gluten-free and vegan items, providing clear positive evidence for that amenity. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or device charging appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null; notably the contact page lists a second phone number (778-484-7444) absent from OSM.
concerns: Website contact page lists a second phone number (778-484-7444) not present in OSM; one or both numbers may be valid and OSM may need updating.
Business operates under a combined brand name 'Pulp Fiction Coffee House® & Robbie Rare Books' on the website, whereas OSM records only 'Pulp Fiction Coffee House'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, distinctive downtown Kelowna café with confirmed contact details, gluten-free and vegan menu options, and a welcoming atmosphere well-suited to touring cyclists looking for a memorable mid-ride stop.
